errors.mej-api-missing: Campaign Companion requires a Monk's Enhanced Journal version with the extension API. The module is disabled.

autoLink.name: Auto-Link Entry Names
autoLink.hint: When enabled, newly-typed mentions of other Monk's Enhanced Journal entry names in a page's text are automatically turned into links as the page is saved. Existing links, code blocks, and pages flagged to opt out are left untouched.

autoCaptureEncounters.name: Auto-Capture Encounters
autoCaptureEncounters.hint: When enabled, ending a combat creates (or updates) an Encounter journal entry summarizing the participants and outcome, and files it onto the campaign timeline's newest timepoint.

autoCaptureSharedMedia.name: Auto-Capture Shared Media
autoCaptureSharedMedia.hint: When enabled, images and videos a GM shows to players are automatically filed onto the campaign timeline's newest timepoint.

session.dragActorHint: Drag an Actor here to add them as an attendee.
